name: Houshou Kotoko
source:
Wife of the main character, Hayato.
She is the only daughter of the Hosei family, which is involved in a number of major corporations.
When she was a university student, Yuto helped her when she was in trouble on the street, and she fell in love with him at first sight.
Her fierce attraction to him led to a relationship and marriage, despite the difference in their status.
She has a strong love for Yuto that never wavers, even when her family and friends speak ill of him.
She never stops believing that she will be able to overcome her love due to the difference in status.
She is currently trying to have a baby with Yuto.
